# A fake nvcc prints recorded ptxas -v output and writes the fatbin; a fake
# cuobjdump prints recorded SASS. The real tools are not needed.
[!exec:sh] skip
chmod 0755 nvcc cuobjdump pfx

exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -cuobjdump $WORK/cuobjdump -launchers -sass k.cu
stdout '^sm_90a +entry +32 +- +128 +0 +0 +512 +1 +_Z5scaleILi128EEvPfPKfi$'
stdout '^sm_90a +device +0 .* _Z6helperfi$'
stdout '^sm_90a +entry +32 +- +992 +2232 +2660 +0 +0 +_Z5spillPfPKf$'
stdout 'SASS sm_90a _Z5scaleILi128EEvPfPKfi: 128 instructions, 1 local loads, 8 local stores: FFMA=32 LDC.64=18'

# The wrapper takes each launcher's address so templates instantiate.
exec cat args
stdout '-gencode=arch=compute_90a,code=sm_90a'
stdout '-Xptxas -v'
exec cat wrap
stdout '^void\* cudacompilecheck_keep_0 = \(void\*\)&launch_scale;$'

# Gates.
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -no-spill k.cu
stdout 'FAIL: sm_90a _Z5spillPfPKf: spills 2232 B stores, 2660 B loads'
stderr 'gate failed'
# -spill-allow pins a known spill: at its recorded bytes the gate passes
# and says so; 4 more bytes of stores or loads fail it.
exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -spill-allow allow.txt k.cu
stdout 'note: sm_90a _Z5spillPfPKf: spills 2232 B stores, 2660 B loads, within the 2232, 2660 allowed by -spill-allow line 2'
stdout 'note: -spill-allow line 3 \(_Z4gone.\*\) matches no function'
! stdout FAIL
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -spill-allow allow-st.txt k.cu
stdout 'FAIL: sm_90a _Z5spillPfPKf: spills 2232 B stores, 2660 B loads, over the 2228, 2660 allowed by -spill-allow line 1'
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -spill-allow allow-ld.txt k.cu
stdout 'FAIL: sm_90a _Z5spillPfPKf: spills 2232 B stores, 2660 B loads, over the 2232, 2656 allowed by -spill-allow line 1'
# An unlisted spilling function still fails, and the regexp is anchored.
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -spill-allow allow-prefix.txt k.cu
stdout 'FAIL: sm_90a _Z5spillPfPKf: spills 2232 B stores, 2660 B loads$'
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -spill-allow allow-bad.txt k.cu
stderr 'allow-bad.txt:1: want regexp max_store_bytes max_load_bytes'

! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -max-registers 24 k.cu
stdout 'FAIL: sm_90a _Z5scaleILi128EEvPfPKfi: 32 registers > 24'
exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -max-registers 32 k.cu

# With -exec the tool runs under timeout(1) on the far side, because the
# local process group holds only the prefix.
exec cudacompilecheck -exec $WORK/pfx -timeout 90s -nvcc $WORK/nvcc k.cu
stdout '_Z5spillPfPKf'
exec cat pfxlog
stdout '^timeout -k 5 90s mkdir -p /tmp/cudacompilecheck-'
stdout '^timeout -k 5 90s rm -rf /tmp/cudacompilecheck-'

# Compiles also hold a lock on the compiling host, so concurrent users
# queue; the local limit grows by -lock-wait.
stdout '^flock -E 75 -w 1800 /tmp/cudacompilecheck.lock timeout -k 5 90s .*/nvcc '
! stdout 'flock .* mkdir'
rm pfxlog
exec cudacompilecheck -exec $WORK/pfx -lock '' -nvcc $WORK/nvcc k.cu
exec cat pfxlog
stdout '^timeout -k 5 300s .*/nvcc '
! stdout flock
cp nvcc busy
! exec cudacompilecheck -exec $WORK/pfx -lock $WORK/l -lock-wait 2s -nvcc $WORK/nvcc k.cu
stderr 'waited 2s for .*/l on the compiling host; another compile holds it'
rm busy

# A tool missing from the compiling host is named.
! exec cudacompilecheck -exec $WORK/pfx -sass -cuobjdump nosuchcuobjdump -nvcc $WORK/nvcc k.cu
stderr 'cuobjdump: exit status 127 \(nosuchcuobjdump not found on the compiling host; -cuobjdump gives its path\)'
! exec cudacompilecheck -sass -cuobjdump $WORK/nosuchcuobjdump -nvcc $WORK/nvcc k.cu
stderr 'nosuchcuobjdump not found on the compiling host'
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc nosuchnvcc k.cu
stderr 'nosuchnvcc not found on the compiling host; -nvcc gives its path'

# Entry gates: the fixture has two entry functions and one device function.
exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -count 2 -want-entries '_Z5spillPfPKf,_Z5scale.*' k.cu
! stdout FAIL
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -count 3 k.cu
stdout 'FAIL: sm_90a: 2 entry functions, want 3'
stderr 'gate failed'

# A missing kernel fails, named; device functions are not entries.
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -want-entries want.txt k.cu
stdout 'FAIL: sm_90a: no entry function matches "_Z6missingv"'
stdout 'FAIL: sm_90a: no entry function matches "_Z6helperfi"'
! stdout 'matches "_Z5spill'
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -want-entries '(' k.cu
stderr 'want-entries: error parsing regexp'

# PTX census, counted per function from nvcc -ptx output.
exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -ptx -top 2 k.cu
stdout '^  PTX sm_90a _Z5scaleILi128EEvPfPKfi: 32 instructions, 0 local loads, 0 local stores: mov.u32=4 add.s32=3$'
stdout '^  PTX sm_90a _Z6helperfi: 82 instructions, 1 local loads, 8 local stores: ld.const.f32=32 fma.rn.f32=31$'
! stdout SASS

# -save-sass writes the listing it counted and implies -sass.
exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -cuobjdump $WORK/cuobjdump -save-sass sassout k.cu
stdout 'SASS sm_90a _Z5scaleILi128EEvPfPKfi: 128 instructions'
cmp sassout/k.sm_90a.sass scale.sass

# -save-ptx writes the PTX it counted and implies -ptx.
exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -save-ptx ptxout -top 2 k.cu
stdout '^  PTX sm_90a _Z5scaleILi128EEvPfPKfi: 32 instructions'
cmp ptxout/k.sm_90a.ptx small.ptx

# JSON.
exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -json k.cu
stdout '"SpillStores": 2232'

# Compiler failure shows the compiler's output.
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -D FAIL k.cu
stderr 'nvcc: exit status 1'
stderr 'error: boom'

! exec cudacompilecheck -arch sm90 k.cu
stderr 'bad architecture "sm90"'

-- pfx --
#!/bin/sh
# A stand-in for limactl shell: log, drop timeout(1), run locally.
echo "$@" >> $WORK/pfxlog
if [ "$1" = flock ]; then
	[ -e $WORK/busy ] && exit 75
	shift 6
fi
[ "$1" = timeout ] && shift 4
command -v "$1" >/dev/null || exit 127
exec "$@"
-- want.txt --
# kernels the generator emits
_Z5spillPfPKf
_Z5scaleILi128EEvPfPKfi

_Z6missingv
_Z6helperfi
-- k.cu --
template <int N> __global__ void scale(float* y) {}
inline void launch_scale(float* y) { scale<128><<<1, 128>>>(y); }
-- nvcc --
#!/bin/sh
echo "$@" > $WORK/args
out=
prev=
ptx=
for a in "$@"; do
	[ "$prev" = -o ] && out=$a
	[ "$a" = -ptx ] && ptx=1
	case $a in -DFAIL) echo 'k.cu(1): error: boom' >&2; exit 1;; esac
	prev=$a
	last=$a
done
if [ -n "$ptx" ]; then
	cp $WORK/small.ptx "$out"
	exit 0
fi
cp "$last" $WORK/wrap
: > "$out"
cat $WORK/ptxas.txt >&2
-- allow.txt --
# copied from the spill owner
_Z5spill.* 2232 2660
_Z4gone.* 8 8
-- allow-st.txt --
_Z5spill.* 2228 2660
-- allow-ld.txt --
_Z5spill.* 2232 2656
-- allow-prefix.txt --
_Z5sp 9999 9999
-- allow-bad.txt --
_Z5spill.* 2232
-- cuobjdump --

cat $WORK/scale.sass
